play.where: Player bar along the bottom, and the play button on a file row (All music, later Review).

pause.where: Player bar along the bottom, and the play button on the file that is playing.

playNamed.purpose: Screen-reader name of a row's play button; the file's name is data.
playNamed.where: Play button on a file row (screen-reader label).

pauseNamed.purpose: Screen-reader name of a row's play button while that file plays.
pauseNamed.where: Play button on the file that is playing (screen-reader label).

position.purpose: Screen-reader name of the scrub bar.
position.where: Player bar along the bottom, on the waveform that is the seek bar (screen-reader label).

previous.purpose: Button that goes to the track above in the list; after the first 3 seconds of a track it starts the track over instead.
previous.where: Player bar along the bottom, left of play/pause (hover text and screen-reader name).

next.purpose: Button that goes to the track below in the list.
next.where: Player bar along the bottom, right of play/pause (hover text and screen-reader name).

mute.purpose: Button that turns the sound off, keeping the volume.
mute.where: Player bar along the bottom, left of the volume slider (hover text and screen-reader name).

unmute.purpose: Button that turns the sound back on.
unmute.where: Player bar along the bottom, left of the volume slider while the sound is off (hover text and screen-reader name).

volume.purpose: Screen-reader name of the volume slider.
volume.where: Player bar along the bottom, at the right end (screen-reader label).

refused.missing.purpose: Says why a file isn't played: it isn't on disk.
refused.missing.where: Player bar, in place of the scrub bar, when the file is gone.
refused.missing.approved: Can't play: the file is missing

refused.driveNotConnected.purpose: Says why a file isn't played: its drive is unplugged.
refused.driveNotConnected.where: Player bar, in place of the scrub bar, when the file's drive isn't connected.
refused.driveNotConnected.approved: Can't play: the file's drive isn't connected

refused.onlineOnly.purpose: Says why a file isn't played: it's a OneDrive file that isn't on this PC, and playing it would download it.
refused.onlineOnly.where: Player bar, in place of the scrub bar, for an online-only OneDrive file.
refused.onlineOnly.approved: Can't play: the file is online only (not downloaded)

refused.cantPlay.purpose: Says a file isn't played because it can't be read or decoded as audio.
refused.cantPlay.where: Player bar, in place of the scrub bar, for a file the player can't use (unknown, unreadable or not decodable).

waveform.label.purpose: Screen-reader name of the waveform drawing of the loaded file.
waveform.label.where: Player bar along the bottom, beside the scrub bar (screen-reader label).

waveform.notReady.purpose: Says the waveform of the loaded file is not drawn yet: a background task draws them after a scan.
waveform.notReady.where: Player bar along the bottom, in place of the waveform, until the background task has reached the file (screen-reader label).

waveform.unavailable.purpose: Says no waveform will come for the loaded file because its audio can't be decoded.
waveform.unavailable.where: Player bar along the bottom, in place of the waveform, for a file that can't be decoded (screen-reader label).
